title: Start with the business need
tell: Harborview needs warehouse financing; the bank needs evidence and a clear decision.
show: Follow the borrower, then the loan officer.
land: Shorten the path from application to funding.
click: Portal → Start an application → pause on the form.
details: Box holds the documents; Salesforce holds the loan record; Claude guides the officer.

title: Create the application
origin: Fresh capture · form only; no application submitted in this capture
show: Enter $4.8 million, 120 months, and real estate collateral.
land: Reduce intake rework with one shared loan record.
click: Commercial Real Estate → 4,800,000 → 120 months → purpose → Real Estate → Submit application.
details: Keep the newly created loan selected for the rest of the demo.

title: Upload the documents
origin: Earlier September 10 rehearsal · upload success · older table styling
tell: Deliver the package without labeling every file manually.
show: Upload the documents; watch classification update the checklist.
land: Reduce document chasing with a complete loan file.
click: Upload document → select six supporting PDFs → Upload → wait for success → Close. Add the markup.
details: Upload six supporting PDFs plus the marked-up term sheet. Confirm the files appear on the same Salesforce loan.

title: Preview the appraisal
origin: Fresh capture · current loan appraisal preview
tell: Keep the supporting evidence within reach.
show: Open the appraisal directly in the workspace.
land: Resolve questions faster with the source in view.
details: The appraisal values the property at $5.65 million and excludes personal property.

title: Find critical risks
land: Prioritize critical risks before they delay closing.
click: Claude: “What’s the status of Harborview’s distribution facility loan? Which documents in that loan are flagged critical policy risk?”
details: Use the application just created and scope the search to its folder.

title: Check credit policy
tell: Separate borrower requests from bank policy.
show: Compare the markup with cited policy requirements.
land: Catch policy exceptions before they become costly rework.
click: Claude: “Extract loan terms from the marked-up term sheet for that loan and check them against credit policy.”
details: Compare borrower requests with cited policy; keep requested and approved terms distinct.

title: Confirm record changes
origin: Fresh capture · current record summary; not proof of a write in this capture
tell: Analysis should not silently change the record.
show: Review the proposed values, confirm the write, then check the result.
land: Reduce rekeying errors while keeping people in control.
click: Claude: “Validate those terms against the Salesforce record.” Review, then: “Apply only the reviewed amount, rate and term to this loan, confirm.”
details: Apply only the reviewed amount, rate and term. Re-read the record to confirm the changes.

title: Compare prior loans
tell: Check what this borrower previously accepted.
show: Compare the executed agreements with today’s markup.
land: Strengthen credit decisions with relevant precedent.
click: Claude: “Compare the covenant terms across Harborview’s prior executed loans and this 2026 markup.”
details: Compare covenant thresholds, test frequency, guaranties and signatories.

title: Record approval
origin: Fresh capture · six documents approved and loan Approved; decisions not performed in this capture
tell: Document review and loan approval are separate decisions.
land: Keep the loan moving with accountable approvals.
click: Review document statuses → confirm the intended approval scope → verify authorized loan approval → refresh workspace.
details: Document approval and loan approval are separate. Confirm both before sending for signature.

title: Generate and send the letter
origin: Fresh capture · successfully populated retry PDF in Box
tell: Turn approved terms into a populated letter and a governed signature request.
land: Reduce paperwork and accelerate borrower acceptance.
click: Claude: Generate the commitment letter for this loan and send it for signature using the confirmed signer. → continue or confirm the recommended action when needed → inspect the exact generated output
details: The assistant checks the generated letter before sending it to the confirmed signer.

title: Sign the letter
origin: Earlier September 10 rehearsal · full-canvas signing before submission
tell: The borrower explicitly opens the signing ceremony.
show: Dana chooses Review and sign to open the signing workspace.
land: Make signing convenient and speed up closing.
click: Portal: Review and sign → accept disclosure → Begin → enter signature → Sign & Finish → return to workspace
details: Box confirms completion before the portal closes the signing pane and updates the loan.

title: Open the signed documents
origin: Live borrower portal capture: retained signed letter and Closed loan.
tell: Signing completes this loan, and the borrower keeps access to the records.
show: Verify Closed, then open the signed commitment letter and signing log.
land: Give borrowers lasting access to their signed records.
click: Wait for the workspace to return → verify loan status Closed → open Signed Commitment Letter → return to documents → open Signing Log → refresh and verify both remain
details: The loan is Closed. The signed letter and signing log remain available; supporting-document review totals stay separate.

title: Close the story
origin: Live deployed portal: one consolidated document list and Closed loan.
tell: We started with an application and a document package.
show: Review the Closed loan, document list, and retained signing history.
land: Close loans faster with traceable decisions and documents.
click: Return to workspace → point to Closed, Documents, and Document history.
details: Box connects the evidence, Salesforce records the decisions, and people authorize the actions.
